market_outlook.short_term: Risk-off dominates. Oil-driven inflation keeps yields elevated, pressuring equities and gold. Iran conflict is the primary swing factor—any de-escalation would trigger a sharp relief rally. Bond markets remain in stress mode with Japan's 3% milestone signaling structural shift. Fed rate-hike bets create headwinds for growth. Canada and high-yield credit are vulnerable. AI capex names may pull back on Goldman's overbuild warning but remain supported by massive deal flow. Expect elevated VIX and commodity volatility through September.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle (Anthropic $35B, Nvidia golden age) supports multi-year tech leadership but Goldman's capex shocker warning implies a correction risk within 6-12 months. Bond yield normalization is structural—Japan at 3% won't reverse. India's diaspora-driven capital inflows and rupee strength suggest sustained EM outperformance. Energy transition accelerates as Hormuz bypass plans and climate repricing reshape infrastructure. Autonomous vehicle competition (Waymo vs. Tesla) will define next transport cycle. Insurance consolidation (Aon/USI) and fintech regulation easing (crypto perps) create sector tailwinds. Mortgage debt sustainability in NZ signals housing market stabilization but economic softness persists.
